name: Sacred Timeline · Films
note: Earth-616, the main MCU reality. This is the main line.

name: Sacred Timeline · Series
note: Marvel Studios series and specials set on Earth-616.

name: Sacred Timeline · Marvel TV
note: Netflix and ABC-era shows. Loosely tied to Earth-616; the Netflix heroes are now firmly canon.

name: TVA · Outside time
note: The Time Variance Authority exists outside every timeline, so it has no year of its own.

name: Earth-828 · Fantastic Four
note: A retro-future 1960s Earth, home of the Fantastic Four.

name: Earth-10005 · Fox X-Men
note: The 20th Century Fox X-Men and Deadpool films. Its history was rewritten once, in Days of Future Past.

name: Legacy universes
note: Older standalone Marvel films (Blade, Daredevil, Elektra, Fantastic Four). Each is its own universe; several heroes resurface in the Void.

name: Sony's Spider-Man Universe
note: Venom, Morbius, Madame Web and Kraven.

name: Other universes
note: What If…? branches, the Spider-Verse, X-Men '97 and other alternate realities.
